THE FRAMEWORK GATE OF ₩1,867,213 IS NOW ₩466,213 ABOVE THE CLOSE — 33.3% AWAY. SKHY US ADR FELL 8.98% TO $130.17 IN US TRADING (REFLECTS FOMC + EARNINGS REACTION TOGETHER).

decision.rationale: SK Hynix's Q2 2026 results present the purest 'earnings beat punished' paradox of the AI semiconductor era: operating profit up 557% YoY, operating margin 76% (potentially the highest in semiconductor history), HBM4 mass production begun — yet the stock fell 9.61% because consensus expectations of ₩84.12T revenue and ₩64.1T operating profit were not met. Management explicitly addressed this on the earnings call and raised full-year capex guidance to the high ₩40T range, signed multi-year supply agreements with ~10 customers, and maintained that H2 DRAM shipments will grow +10% QoQ. The problem is the market's timing: the earnings miss (however temporary) reinforces the 'AI peak' narrative that has driven the stock down 37.4% from its ₩2,237,000 high (extrapolated from ₩2,987,000 52-week high data) in the past 30 days. The gate at ₩1,867,213 now requires a 33.3% recovery — achievable only across multiple strong sessions driven by H2 earnings delivery. The China DUV structural threat (July 28) and today's earnings miss are now priced in; the next derating catalyst would be a Q3 2026 earnings miss (if HBM4 H2 ramp disappoints) or an additional deterioration in NVIDIA AI capex demand. The framework does not re-engage until the gate is reclaimed.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — New all-time framework low; earnings miss on record results; second consecutive major decline

SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed ₩1,401,000 on 2026-07-29, down −₩149,000 / −9.61% from the July 28 KRX close of ₩1,550,000. This is the second consecutive session with a major decline (July 28: −14.65%; July 29: −9.61%) and sets a new 52-week low, breaking below the prior ₩1,550,000 floor set on July 28. The two-day combined decline: −₩415,000 / −22.84% from the July 28 close of ₩1,816,000.

### Q2 Earnings — The paradox of record results and investor disappointment

| Metric | Q2 Reported | Q2 Consensus | vs. Consensus | YoY Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ₩79.32T | ₩84.12T | −5.7% MISS | +257% |
| Operating profit | ₩60.54T | ₩64.10T | −5.6% MISS | +557% |
| Operating margin | 76.24% | ~76% | IN-LINE | n/a |
| Net profit | ₩93.92T | — | — | n/a |

The miss on absolute levels (₩4.8T revenue, ₩3.56T OP) was entirely attributed to HBM4 shipment timing: some deliveries originally planned for Q2 were pushed to H2 due to customer qualification timing and yield ramp pacing. The 76% operating margin (in-line with consensus) demonstrates the pricing power and cost structure are intact. The year-over-year comparison (+257% revenue, +557% OP) is extraordinary by any industry standard.

### Why record results triggered a −9.61% decline

1. **Expectation vs. actuality gap**: The consensus of ₩84.12T revenue was derived from sell-side models built on aggressive HBM4 ramp assumptions; the timing miss was a model failure, not a demand failure; but markets respond to numbers vs. estimates, not numbers vs. last year.

2. **'AI Peak' narrative capture**: The timing miss gave market participants who believe AI capex is peaking a data point to cite; 'even SK Hynix with the best margins in semiconductor history is missing estimates' became the headline; the narrative captured the stock regardless of whether the miss was structural or timing.

3. **Entry into earnings at extreme pessimism (₩1,550,000, circuit-breaker floor)**: The July 28 close at ₩1,550,000 already priced in significant risk; the Q2 miss on top of an already-distressed price produced a compounding effect rather than a recovery.

4. **China DUV discount not cleared**: Management's earnings call response to China DUV competition was generic; the structural discount applied on July 28 was not removed by the earnings call; it persists as an additional valuation headwind.

### Trend — Third consecutive lower KRX close; gate gap at historic extreme

| Session | KRX close | vs. gate | Change | Session character |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| July 27 | ₩1,816,000 | −₩51,213 | +₩57,000 (+3.24%) | Close at session HIGH |
| July 28 | ₩1,550,000 | −₩317,213 | −₩266,000 (−14.65%) | Close at session LOW |
| July 29 | ₩1,401,000 | −₩466,213 | −₩149,000 (−9.61%) | New 52-week low |

Three-session decline: −₩415,000 / −22.84%. Gate gap: ₩51,213 → ₩317,213 → ₩466,213 (widening each session). The trend is firmly bearish with no recovery attempt.

### Momentum — RSI extreme (estimated 10-15); two consecutive forced-selling events

Two consecutive forced-selling sessions (circuit breaker July 28, earnings-miss July 29) have pushed estimated RSI to 10-15 — among the most extreme oversold readings possible for a large-cap stock. At RSI below 15, the only remaining sellers are fundamentally-motivated (structural thesis change, index rebalancing) or technically-forced (margin calls, risk limits). Organic sellers at ₩1,401,000 with full knowledge of the 76% margin and 557% YoY growth are rare. This RSI extreme is the strongest technical signal in the framework period that a bottom is near — but the catalyst to trigger recovery is not in place until H2 HBM4 delivery data or NVDA August 26 earnings provides external validation.

### Volume — Two forced-selling sessions; circuit-breaker characteristics

Specific KRX volume data is not available, but the context (circuit breaker July 28, −14.65%; earnings-miss selloff July 29, −9.61%) is consistent with extraordinarily elevated volume across both sessions. The KOSPI two-day decline of −16.3% confirms systemic forced selling beyond individual stock dynamics. Two-day circuit-breaker-adjacent events in Korean markets historically produce the highest-volume, most price-dislocated conditions in the market — and historically precede recoveries once forced selling exhausts.

### Strongest support — ₩1,401,000 (July 29 close; earnings-miss floor)

Set by a combination of earnings-miss selling and pre-FOMC risk reduction. The floor has two properties:
- **Temporary nature of the miss**: The HBM4 timing delay is explicitly quantifiable; management's raised capex guidance suggests they expect H2 to deliver; if Q3 closes the gap, the miss was noise not signal.
